data: It's here: IncusGrid for iPhone and iPad
IncusGrid is now in the App Store: plan passages on the 10-day forecast, take them offline to sea, and see how protected an anchorage is over the next 72 hours.
More room on the map: one sheet for every layer
Look back at years of data or ahead at the forecast, pick one background, and show berths and sailing routes on top: over the wind forecast, thunderstorm days, the seabed or a satellite map.
From two clicks to a passage plan: weather routing in IncusGrid
Set start and destination, pick your boat, and get a fast route on the ECMWF forecast: arrival, strongest wind, motoring hours and departure comparisons.
